limitations: Two Neel source groups and one Chris group support descriptive development only. No human-population, source-population or general fidelity claim.
Order reversals, extraction replicates and aliases do not add independent judgments.
P7 has extra approved peer fitting evidence; this is a declared intervention difference.
All controls are fresh matched f6 results; phase1 controls remain historical and are not reused here.
Promotions are selected on development data for more replication, not confirmed best methods or finalists.
Sparse and richer corpora remain separate interventions.
Two prior uncertain paid extraction calls remain failures with retained cost bounds; no retry or erased hold.
